html: † נִסְרֹךְ n.pr.div. Assyrian god, worshipped by Sennach., 2 K 19:37 = Is 37:38; 𝔊 Εσδραχ, A Εσθραχ, 𝔊L Ασραχ (K); 𝔊 Νασαραχ, א Ασαρακ, A Ασαραχ (Is); JosAnt. x. 1, 5 Αρασκη; no such god in cuneif. inscr.; see views in MeinhJesaiaerzählungen (1898) ad loc.; crpt. form of Nusku (= נסוך) according to HalJAs. xiii (1879), 387 = Mél. de Crit. 177 Muss-ArnoltJBL xi. 1 (1892), 86; Hbr. vii. 89 R. 17; Nusku is a solar deity, cf. JastrRel. Bab. 220 f.
